releases.name: v0.2.0
releases.notes: ## What's new in 0.2.0 This release hardens the research protocol and ships the evaluation work that came out of comparing this skill against other deep-research skills. ### Sources you cannot open are now handled by rule The strongest primary sources are often behind a paywall or a bot wall. Until now, the right response — record the failure, note the gap, and never pass a snippet off as the original — was implied but not written down. It now is: a blocked page is logged as an observation with its HTTP status, the gap goes into the report as an availability caveat, and a claim whose only support is an unreachable source is labelled `unknown` instead of quietly softened. ### The validator tells you how to fix a failure A failed run used to get a code and a location. releases.name: v1.3.0
releases.notes: Two versions of work are rolled up here (v1.2.0 and v1.3.0). ## Better agent discovery and chain safety - New `scripts/discover-agents.mjs`: a read-only, zero-dependency CLI that lists your custom agents (slim and native sources) and flags risky fallback chains — duplicate model ids, chains outside 2–4 entries, non-Go fallback ids not confirmed in the local registry, and vision lanes whose model is not marked vision-verified. It prints compact JSON instead of making you read config files by hand. - New `scripts/snapshot-summary.mjs`: a compact digest of the cached model snapshot (~97% shorter than the raw file), with `--ids`, `--trait`, and `--json`. ## Clearer recommendations - The recommendation table now includes a **role overview** column: a one-line, plain-language description of wha…

en.headline: 22 commits across 3 repos; v0.2.0 and v1.3.0 released
en.summary: On 2026-10-04, sogeisetsu made 22 commits across three repositories. In meld-deepresearch (10 commits), work centered on preparing the v0.2.0 release, fixing landing-page and chapter-background issues, adding explicit access-blocked handling and validator hints to the research skill, and documenting live Q2 evaluation comparisons across three skills. In sogeisetsu (10 own commits plus 2 automated commits by github-actions[bot]), changes included switching to Newsreader and 霞鹜文楷 serif fonts with a new favicon, restructuring commit statistics to separate own and bot counts, adding status-change badges with UTC+8 timestamps, and improving AI output resilience. In opencode-go-model-picker (2 commits), new agent-discovery and snapshot-summary scripts were added along with documentation for vision verification and Windows refresh paths. Two releases were published: meld-deepresearch v0.2.0, which formalizes blocked-source handling and adds validator fix hints, and opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0, which introduces the discover-agents and snapshot-summary CLIs plus a role-overview column in recommendations. No pull requests, issues, or reviews were recorded.

releaseNotes.summary: Hardens the research protocol by formalizing blocked-source handling (logging HTTP status, labelling unreachable claims as unknown) and adding validator fix hints to failed runs. Also ships evaluation documentation comparing three deep-research skills.

Adds discover-agents.mjs for listing custom agents and flagging risky fallback chains, plus snapshot-summary.mjs for compact model-snapshot digests. The recommendation table gains a role-overview column.

zh.headline: 3 个仓库共 22 次提交；发布 v0.2.0 与 v1.3.0
zh.summary: 2026 年 10 月 4 日，sogeisetsu 在三个仓库共提交 22 次。在 meld-deepresearch（10 次提交）中，主要工作包括准备 v0.2.0 发布、修复落地页和章节背景问题、为研究技能添加显式的访问受限处理和验证器提示，以及记录三项技能的 Q2 实时评估对比。在 sogeisetsu（10 次本人提交，另有 2 次由 github-actions[bot] 自动提交）中，改动包括切换至 Newsreader 和霞鹜文楷衬线字体并新增 favicon、重构提交统计以区分本人与机器人计数、添加带 UTC+8 时间戳的状态变更徽章，以及增强 AI 输出的容错能力。在 opencode-go-model-picker（2 次提交）中，新增了 agent-discovery 和 snapshot-summary 脚本，并补充了视觉验证和 Windows 刷新路径的文档。当天发布了两个版本：meld-deepresearch v0.2.0，正式规范了受限来源的处理流程并新增验证器修复提示；opencode-go-model-picker v1.3.0，引入 discover-agents 和 snapshot-summary CLI 工具，并在推荐表中增加了角色概览列。当日无合并请求、issue 或代码审查记录。

releaseNotes.summary: 强化研究协议，正式规范受限来源的处理流程（记录 HTTP 状态码、将不可达来源的声明标记为 unknown），并为失败运行添加验证器修复提示。同时发布三项深度研究技能的评估对比文档。
新增 discover-agents.mjs 用于列出自定义 agent 并标记有风险的 fallback 链，以及 snapshot-summary.mjs 用于生成紧凑的模型快照摘要。推荐表新增角色概览列。
